title: Spaghetti alla Cacio e Pepe
description: A classic Italian pasta dish made with just a few ingredients, showcasing the rich flavors of cacio e pepe. This recipe is a staple of Italian cuisine, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining the spaghetti.
In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the cacio e pepe cheese blend and stir until smooth.
Add the reserved pasta water to the cheese sauce and stir to combine.
Add the cooked spaghetti to the cheese sauce and toss until well coated.
Season with black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, topped with additional Grana Padano cheese if desired.
